overview: This event ties together obogs and pressurization system, aborted takeoff, and lost aircraft procedures in a way that should already make sense before you step. You should be ready to brief what changes the plan, what numbers matter, and where the usual errors start once the workload climbs.

children.text: Oxygen Source and Generation
Conditioned bleed air is tapped from the engine and routed to the OBOGS concentrator.
Uses pressure swing adsorption and a molecular sieve to extract oxygen from bleed air and remove nitrogen.
A small tank downstream of the concentrator that holds a short-term oxygen supply in the event of OBOGS failure.
Illuminates when either regulator is set to MAX.

items.text: Discontinued Entry is a mandatory maneuver to safely depart the pattern entry track when proper separation, RDO communication, or traffic alignment is not established. It prevents conflicts with pattern or emergency traffic (e.g., PPEL/P).

children.text: Know the entry airspeed, altitude, configuration, and cockpit setup before you start the maneuver.
